el-baton--el-baton.description: First made in 1914 as a hand-rolled nickel cigar at J.C. Newman's Cleveland factory, El Baton left the market in the 1920s and returned in 2008 as the company's first Nicaraguan cigar, rolled at the PENSA factory in Estelí with aged Nicaraguan binder and filler. It is full and forceful, with pepper, spice, espresso and dark cocoa over leather and earth.

thirds.notes: Pepper and spice come in strong over leather and earth, with a faint raisin-like sweetness on the finish.
The pepper recedes while spice grows; leather and earth hold the centre and the finish turns a little sweeter.
Still full yet smooth, with pepper and sweet leather on the retrohale and an earthy, raisin-tinged close.

sources.title: J.C. Newman blog – El Baton Belicoso review
